neighbours.label: ' start' (and ' first') opening the beginning of a period of activity: start work, the first months
fire: With a shorter course, nursing students can start their placements in the spring.
Apprentices who pass the exam may start earning a full wage right away.
The visa allows refugees to start a job as soon as they arrive.
Moving the deadline lets the builders start construction before the rains.
Early admission means pupils can start secondary school at eleven.
Patients are told to start physiotherapy within days of the operation.
Mothers are urged to rest during the first weeks after giving birth.
Seedlings need daily watering for the first month after planting.
quiet: With a shorter course, nursing students can finish their placements in the spring.
Apprentices who pass the exam may keep earning a full wage after the course.
The visa allows refugees to remain in the country while their case is heard.
Moving the deadline lets the builders complete construction before the rains.
Pupils usually leave secondary school at sixteen or eighteen.
Patients are told to continue physiotherapy for weeks after the operation.
Mothers are urged to rest during the last weeks before giving birth.
Seedlings need less watering once they are well established in the bed.

notes: Probe: 'can start work' 0.43 vs 'can finish paying' 0.12; 'first few weeks' 0.13 vs 'last few weeks' 0.01; early vs late infancy identical (0.14, peak 'begin'); 'Once ... installed' 0.09. Only ' start' was clearly strong; ' first' weak, so the test leans on start. Low confidence.
